_note: Copy this file to jobfill.config.json and edit it. jobfill.config.json is
gitignored, so your own filesystem layout stays out of version control.
Every key here is optional — jobfill.config.json can omit any key you don't
need to override, and an env var named JOBFILL_<KEY_IN_SCREAMING_SNAKE>
(e.g. JOBFILL_RESUME_DIR, JOBFILL_BASE_TEX) always overrides both this file
and the built-in default, useful for one-off runs. helper/paths.mjs owns
the precedence: env var, then this file (as jobfill.config.json), then the
portable default shown below. A leading '~/' expands to your home
directory; any other relative path resolves against the repo root.
resumeDir should contain the base LaTeX resume named by baseTex — that
file is the one required input the tailor endpoint reads.
bulletPool, profileMd, noInflateMd, dropConcMd, voiceProfile, userProfile,
interviewGaps and noInflatedMetrics are OPTIONAL voice/context inputs for
the resume tailor and the on-demand document generators (cover letter,
interview-prep brief, follow-up email). When one of these files is
absent, generation degrades — that section is omitted from the prompt —
rather than failing.
claudeBin and pdflatex are only needed for tailoring and doc generation,
not for the core fill loop. Leave them as-is if either binary is already
on your PATH; the defaults below are probed against common install
locations and fall back to the bare binary name.
